title: Daniel Lain
text:
Hello, my name is Daniel Lain, and I am an Industrial Engineering & Operations Analytics student at the University of Arkansas. I am a passionate and dedicated student committed to contributing to dynamic work environments through a strong work ethic, professionalism, and a positive attitude.
On campus, I serve as a Peer Mentor for the College of Engineering, where I support and guide incoming freshmen as they transition into their first year of college. Through this role, I help students navigate their academic and personal experiences while encouraging them to build the skills and confidence needed to succeed.
After graduation, I plan to pursue a career in the industrial engineering field, where I can apply my knowledge and skills to improve processes, solve complex problems, and contribute to the success of organizations.
